risk.rationale: Verified evidence forms a confirmed account takeover chain: phishing lure from lookalike domain aegean-edu.co (F1) delivered to d.yilmaz@aegean.edu; followed by anomalous bulk SIS access (38 events in 60 min from 185.220.101.7, F2) and impossible travel Amsterdam→Manisa (F3) consistent with remote use of compromised credentials; and persistence/exfiltration via an API-created inbox forwarding rule to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com (F5). The rejected password-spray claim is attributed to shared-NAT background noise and does not weaken the chain. All four key indicators are confirmed with 0.7–0.85 confidence and map to an initial-access → credential-use → persistence/exfiltration sequence.
